question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'persistence'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word in the given context is '**persistence**'.
 
• This term refers to the quality of continuing steadfastly despite difficulties or obstacles.
 
• It aligns with the context of the sentence, which talks about positive stories of determination and resilience during challenging times, making it the most suitable choice.
 
 
• *Example: The **persistence** of the athlete finally paid off when he won the gold medal after years of hard work and training.*

 
 
 

*​​***Correct Usage:__** *Amidst all the chaos and suffering caused by the pandemic, there are some positive stories of grit, **persistence,** and bravado. Some businesses understood the needs of the times to make (2)________profits. Businesses diversified and (3)________successful. Although there are numerous stories of people and business owners (4)__________ due to lockdowns, this small percentage of success stories is like the light at the end of the (5)___________*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Perspiration**: While perspiration refers to sweating, it doesn't aptly fit the context here. The sentence is discussing positive stories during the pandemic, not physical exertion or effort involving sweating.
 
• **Silence**: Silence does not connect well with the idea of positive stories of resilience and determination during tough times. It doesn't contribute to the theme of overcoming challenges mentioned in the sentence.
 
• **Laxity**: Laxity means the quality of being lax or lacking in rigor or strictness. It doesn't resonate with the idea of positive stories of determination and perseverance amid the chaos caused by the pandemic.
